title: Gelfand--Kirillov dimensions of highest weight modules for basic classical Lie superalgebras
summary: We give exact Gelfand--Kirillov (GK) dimension formulas for simple highest weight modules of the basic classical Lie superalgebras considered in this paper. For the type II orthosymplectic algebras $D(m,n)$ and $B(m,n)$, we identify the PBW associated variety as a product of factor supports evaluated at highest weights for two compatible Borel subalgebras. This gives algorithms for arbitrary complex highest weights, without integrality or typicality hypotheses.
